ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& ISPICKVAL(Indexation_Status__c, "Approved by Controlling")
&& (
ISBLANK(Approval_Date__c)
|| ISBLANK(Indexation_Rate_Billed__c)
|| ISBLANK(Indexation_Effective_Date__c)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the following fields : Approval Date, Indexation Rate Billed, Indexation Effective Date
